reviewed_by: Codex macOS stale browser proxy review
reason: On macOS 14+, Wry writes capture proxy settings to the identity WKWebsiteDataStore. A direct tab must clear that setting before first navigation when capture is disabled; another proxied tab in the same identity must remain protected. Select the three existing native-browser security contracts and an arm64 macOS compile check. The affected client journey requires a rebuilt Mac app and remains a manual release gate.
exclusions: No full suites. Core routes, frontend controls, and Playwright web-interface behavior are unchanged. No focused Rust test exercises WKWebsiteDataStore on Linux CI. The affected Mac client is not remotely controllable, so live navigation, production Mac package, physical-device, and reconnect gates are unavailable for this PR; do not claim the operator workflow is complete from these checks.
